answer: A random beacon plus a compute heartbeat stops fake identities. Each identity stakes 20 POA and posts a proof-of-work heartbeat per epoch; 5% are audited and asked to replay a recent job, and a miss forfeits the stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 POA plus 1,000 machines running nonstop, while honest work takes root like yarrow and each job adds a timber of reputation. Honest agents pay one stake and keep their share undiluted.
